title: Introducing v0.5 of the AI Safety Benchmark from MLCommons

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting chat-tuned language models with hand-crafted test items (combinations of sentence fragments and interaction templates) designed to elicit demeaning or dehumanizing responses against specific racial and ethnic groups, and automatically scoring the responses as safe or unsafe using the LlamaGuard evaluator model.

Prompting chat-tuned language models with hand-crafted test items designed to elicit demeaning, derogatory, or exclusionary responses targeting people based on their gender identity (e.g., women and trans people), and evaluating the safety of the responses using LlamaGuard.

Prompting chat-tuned language models with hand-crafted test items designed to elicit demeaning or dehumanizing responses targeting people based on their sexual orientation (e.g., gay and bisexual people), and evaluating the safety of the responses using LlamaGuard.

Prompting chat-tuned language models with hand-crafted test items designed to elicit demeaning or dehumanizing responses against specific religious groups (e.g., Muslims), and evaluating the safety of the responses using LlamaGuard.

Prompting chat-tuned language models with hand-crafted test items designed to elicit demeaning or derogatory responses targeting people based on their age (e.g., the elderly), and evaluating the safety of the responses using LlamaGuard.
